reason: Names the amoCRM account the long-lived token belongs to: the token carries no address, unlike b24's webhook, so the sign-in cannot find the account without it. Review when the vocabulary names an account address: https://github.com/WireCatLabs/cli-base/issues/424

amoCRM's API v4 reads filters, paging and with from the query string and writes from the body, so a raw call needs both; b24's --body alone fits only its POST-only REST. Review when the vocabulary names a raw call's query parameters.
